Metadata.title: PristineCleaner - Clean your desktop, effortlessly
Metadata.description: PristineCleaner is a free, open-source desktop cleaning utility for macOS, Windows, and Linux. Scan caches, remove clutter, and free up disk space.

platformDescriptions.macos: macOS 11 or later (Apple Silicon and Intel)

hero.description: A free, open-source desktop cleaning utility for macOS, Windows, and Linux. Scan caches, remove clutter, and free up disk space from a clean, modern interface.

features.sectionSubtitle: A full suite of tools to keep your system lean and fast.

diskUsageOverview.title: Disk Usage Overview
diskUsageOverview.description: See your disk capacity, used space, and free space at a glance with live progress indicators.

cacheCleanup.title: Cache Cleanup
cacheCleanup.description: Scan and remove caches, logs, and temporary files from common system and app locations.

clutterFinder.title: Clutter Finder
clutterFinder.description: Find large files over a configurable threshold or browse everything in your Downloads folder.

spaceView.title: Space View
spaceView.description: Scan your home directory folder by folder and see exactly where your disk space is going.

appManager.title: App Manager
appManager.description: Browse installed applications sorted by size and uninstall what you no longer need.

safeByDesign.title: Safe by Design
safeByDesign.description: Items are moved to Trash or Recycle Bin first, so you can recover anything deleted by mistake.

screenshots.title: Screenshots
screenshots.subtitle: See PristineCleaner in action.

cta.title: Ready to clean up?
cta.subtitle: Download PristineCleaner for free. No account required, no telemetry, no nonsense.
